product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides supply-chain solutions and trade expertise to businesses seeking a strategic partner to manage their supply chains.
product_one_liner.notes: Mohawk Global describes itself as supply-chain solutions and trade experts serving customers as a strategic business partner, and says it helps businesses integrate data and technology into operations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation does not show a pricing link. The Rates page is an old post with an image rather than a displayed price list, and the transportation-quote page asks customers to request a quote. This supports no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Mohawk Global’s case study says Umbra uses its customs brokerage services, and a separate case study says Frazer & Jones outsourced inbound transportation to Mohawk Global. | named_customers.0: The case study identifies Umbra and says it uses Mohawk Global’s customs brokerage services. | named_customers.1: The case study says Frazer & Jones outsourced its inbound transportation function to Mohawk Global.

employee_band.notes: The company profile gives its size as 201–500 employees, matching the requested band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s About Us page identifies Syracuse, New York as its headquarters location. | hq_country: The About Us page places Mohawk Global’s headquarters in Syracuse, New York; its company listing gives a U.S. address, establishing the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Mohawk Global’s About Us page says it was founded in 1993.

eng_blog.notes: The Knowledge Center index organizes content into trade, tariff, industry, case-study, and general article categories, not an engineering or technical blog; no qualifying product-build posts are shown.

public_docs.notes: Mohawk Global publishes API documentation with multiple sections covering authentication, bookings, brokerage, container tracking, customs, and other topics, including endpoint references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A job-listing page with roles reviewed in October 2026 lists current openings but shows no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: The API documentation, the company’s discussion of AI, and its privacy policy were checked, but none names an AI model or provider; the provider is therefore unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: The company’s privacy policy and information-security section were checked; the page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.

launched_6mo.notes: The corporate-news archive’s launch-like service expansion announcement is the MGCX post dated December 4, 2025, before the May 9–November 9, 2026 window. The August 2026 GlobalLink item is identified as a customer case study, not a new-product or feature announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive-team listing was checked in full, and reviewed executive bios and corporate announcements did not show a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the 12-month window. The bio that states an executive join date gives 2022; the recent association-election announcement concerns an outside association role, not a Mohawk Global leadership change.
